description:
Arajin Tomoshibi's reunion with his old pal Matakara Asamine takes an unexpected turn when they stumble into a brawl with the toughest guys in town. And just when you thought things couldn't get weirder, a colossal genie decides to drop in. Brace yourself for the ultimate showdown. It's the clash of the cool and the magical!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

The current leader of Siguma Squad, who is known to have incredibly powerful kicks, and is the direct rival of [Kenichirou Douman](https://anilist.co/character/321816/Kenichirou-Douman). He is close friends with his right hand man, [Outa Tahide](https://anilist.co/character/321820/Outa-Tahide), the two of them having dominated every middle school in Honki City, giving the two the nickname of "The God Kings". He also has a younger sister, [Mahoro Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321815).

Mahoro is a high school student who [Arajin](https://anilist.co/character/321700/Arajin-Tomoshibi) is deeply in love with. She is the sister of [Marito Jin](https://anilist.co/character/321818/Marito-Jin), and is completely obsessed with him, wanting him all for herself. She doesn't care for Arajin and his advances, and frequently sees him as weird or gross, only keeping him around so she can manipulate him into doing what she wants from him. While she tends to keep a cutesy, sweet look on the exterior, especially around her brother, she isn't afraid to get serious and show her more manipulative, intimidating side around people she dislikes.

A middle-aged business man who constantly finds himself visiting Nyan Nynight Love, acting as a running gag. He has a special relationship with Jasmine, who he always requests [the host](https://anilist.co/character/324567/Shijuurou-Momotari) to allow him to spend time with.
